headline: Is virtual asset trading subject to business tax? MOF answers: Bitcoin and stablecoin trading not taxed, NFTs are... - Finance
summary: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance said that under the draft Virtual Asset Act, business sales of bitcoin, ether and stablecoins are treated as payment or investment instruments and not taxed. NFT treatment differs.
why: Clear tax treatment of virtual assets affects how crypto exchanges and businesses operate and price their services in Taiwan's regulated market.
